# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- If there is a big bug, trace the runtime and dino code in multiple paths.
- If you haven't observed the runtime and dino code to learn the language, do that. For documentation, start from [DinoLang Wiki](https://github.com/christopheraliprantis/dinolang/wiki) and parse from that webpage.

## Build Instructions
- Build using `./publish`; do not run it unless the user explicitly asks.
